# Synthetic attachment corpus

All files were constructed for issue #1128. No customer/SAP documents or personal data.
Office/ODF packages contain a minimal cost document/table/slide, without macros,
external relationships, embedded objects or formulas. PDF offsets are computed;
images are uniform 16×16 pixels. Media files contain generated silence/black video.
The corpus is test input, not an interoperability certification for SAP or Office.
